name: agy-readable
description: Rebuild Claude's hard-to-read Korean answers into plain, clearly structured Korean with agy (Antigravity CLI), on your own Antigravity sign-in, then have agy check the rewrite against the original and fix what it added. Code, numbers, paths, links and marks such as 추정 are checked to come through; otherwise the original is shown.

model.title: agy model
model.description: Model agy rewrites and checks with (`agy models` lists them). High is too slow for two passes: polishing a 5,354-character answer took it 43.7 s against 13.8 s for Low.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for agy, both passes together, before showing the original answer instead.

review.title: Check the rewrite against the original
review.description: Second pass: agy compares its rewrite with the original, sentence by sentence, and fixes what it added or changed. Off is faster but leaves those.

notes.title: Show skip notes
notes.description: Add one line under an answer shown unrewritten, saying why (timeout, agy error, a number that changed).

retries.title: Retries after a failed check
retries.description: How many times a rewrite that fails a check is asked for again, told what was wrong, while the timeout leaves time for it. 0 shows the original at once.

keep.title: Rewrites kept for comparing
keep.description: How many originals and rewrites to keep on this computer (plugin data dir, samples/, readable by you only) for `agy-readable samples` and `diff`. 0 keeps none.
